messages:
Anna K.: hey team — opening a thread for the model-catalog docs updates tied to the latest benchmarking run. need: a short migration snippet for the SDK (embeddings + batch examples), a note about the updated embed limits for Zephyr-Extended-70B, and a micro-benchmark table. cc @Mike H. @Jess R. :eyes:
Mike H.: on it. which SDK version do we want to show? older snippets still use the legacy client call and it confused a couple of users in the last PR review.
Jess R.: let's show v2-style calls (client.embeddings.create) and a tiny migration snippet that maps old -> new. keep it short. I'll update the model card limits too.
Sam T.: bench summary from infra: Zephyr-Extended-70B (fp16, q4) embedding throughput: 18 req/s (single stream), p95 latency ~220ms, max input tokens for embed pipeline is 8192. we should call out the 8k input limit explicitly.
Anna K.: perfect — please also add a compatibility note: older runtimes (runtime <= 2024-11-01) don't support the quantized KV cache layout we used in this run. fallback will route to the 70B-nonextended variant. Jess can we phrase that as an explicit bullet under "compatibility"?
Jess R.: yes. proposed text: "Note: Zephyr-Extended-70B uses an updated KV cache format. Requests routed to runtimes older than 2024-11-01 will automatically fall back to Zephyr-70B (non-extended). See runtime compatibility matrix for details."
Leo P.: on the SDK snippet — here's a compact migration example you can paste (feel free to trim):
```
# legacy
emb = client.embed("the quick brown fox")

# new (v2)
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="zephyr-extended-70b-embed", input=["the quick brown fox"])
vector = resp.data[0].embedding
```
Make sure to add a note about batching: prefer input lists for throughput.
Mike H.: added a small batching example and a note about max input length. commit in my branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 (draft).
Anna K.: linking the bench artifact: https://bench.internal/reports/zephyr-ext-70b/2026-03-18 — includes raw logs and latency histograms. can someone pull the 95th percentile numbers for the doc?
Sam T.: grabbed them — p95 token latency: 10.2ms/token (text->embed path), p99: 24.7ms/token. I'll paste a tiny table for the card.
Jess R.: draft doc snippet for the model card limits section: "Max embedding input tokens: 8192. Recommended batch size: 8-32 (varies by GPU). Throughput (single-host fp16, q4): ~18 req/s for single-request workloads; use batching for higher aggregate throughput." Thoughts?
Anna K.: that's great. add an explicit "Known caveats" bullet: "Large single-request inputs may hit memory limits on older dedicated stacks — use chunking."
Leo P.: also add example CLI command for running the micro-bench locally: `rdi bench --model zephyr-extended-70b-embed --batch 16 --input-shape 4096`
Mike H.: updated the PR with Jess's text + Leo's CLI + my SDK snippet. also fixed a broken link to the runtime matrix.
docs-bot: PR opened by @mikeh: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — labels: docs, needs-review
Jess R.: reviewers: @Anna K., @Leo P. — will look this afternoon. if no blockers I'll merge and backfill the model card entry. :thumbsup:
Anna K.: quick manual check done — small nit on wording (changed "single-host" -> "single-GPU"), otherwise LGTM. please merge after CI.
Mike H.: CI green, merging now.
docs-bot: PR merged by @mikeh (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412) — deployed to staging docs site.
Anna K.: awesome, thanks everyone. I'll close the related issue and schedule a short follow-up to monitor user questions.
Sam T.: noted, I'll add the bench artifact link to the release notes.
